fact: The DGSN's 2023 annual review states it developed the national trusted-third-party identity platform and launched the Mon identité numérique app, and issued 4,269,781 new-generation CNIE in 2023 at its own Rabat and Marrakech centres.
title: Sécurité – Bilan 2023 des services de la Sûreté nationale (DGSN)
